title: More ways to build with Pollinations
summary:
A community-heavy day brought ComfyUI nodes and a varied crop of apps, alongside a fix for failing text requests.

The app directory added a community-built ComfyUI integration with BYOP nodes for image, video, text, and audio generation, plus model dropdowns that sync from the API. It also added a terminal coding agent, two web-app builders, and a library bridging Pollinations images to OpenAI-compatible APIs.

Seven community additions span agent-generated art, anime illustrations, retro AI-persona homepages, prompt-based galleries, styled image generation, custom stickers, and cinematic soundtrack concepts.

The catalog added child-friendly story generation, text simplification, markdown notes enriched with AI, and interactive fiction. New bot and agent listings cover fraud-prevention research, legal analysis, Telegram characters, and personality typing.
